name: The Saintess and the Wolf
source:
Leave the Church of Equinox by the end of the day.

...was the verdict that Riannon received, but there is someone she wanted to see before she leaves the place she called home.

And with it, some very uncomfortable conversations.

[From [url=https://karita0101.itch.io/the-saintess-and-the-wolf]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当天结束时离开春分教堂。

……这是莉安农收到的判决，但在她离开这个她称之为家的地方之前，她想见一个人。

随之而来的是一些非常不舒服的谈话。

[来自[url=https://karita0101.itch.io/the-saintess-and-the-wolf]itch.io[/url]]
